# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_PUTS_20

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring VIX >= 20 for PUT entries will avoid losses on low-VIX loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07 PUT) while preserving high-VIX winner day entries (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). This targets J's edge by reducing engine losses on losing days without affecting winner day capture, based on playbook VIX confirmation rules for puts (VIX should be rising OR already above 20 at time of entry; VIX below 15 = do not enter puts).

## Mechanism

Add filter: `j_vwap_cont_put_vix_gate` (already exists in VWAP_CONTINUATION) but extend to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON PUT path. Entry logic unchanged; exit logic unchanged. New condition: only allow BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON PUT entries when real-time VIX >= 20.0. Uses same VIX source as existing gate (`j_vwap_cont_put_vix_gate` leverages `macro_vix_watcher`). No new code; reuses existing VIX observation infrastructure.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per playbook position sizing table).  
2. **Sample bias:** Using J's 6 anchor days as proxy; high overfit risk due to tiny sample (n=6). Selection method: manual annotation of J's source-of-truth trades.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not validated with realistic simulator).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/04 VIX <20 (false negative) → miss +$730 winner; max drawdown: consecutive low-VIX loser days skipped but high-VIX whipsaw losses accumulate; blow-up scenario: VIX spike >40 causes premature exits on winners.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X).
